title: truly TINY dial
text:
truly TINY dial. howdy y'all,

the specs - when you dig down enuf to find them - show clearly that the dial is 1" diameter. however, the display image seems to be designed to conceal that ... the image makes the dial look more in the 1.5 to 2.0 inch size.

it works. it's fairly accurate. it's TINY. it's hard to read.

rated a TWO due to a deceptive image that makes the dial seem larger than it is.

take care,
lee
